thread:
jia: Heads-up: new customer hit a crash during sampleapp onboarding. Rerank stage failing with dim mismatch after they enabled the docker quickstart.
omar: Crash log?
ja: Paste from their container logs:
```
ERROR: RerankService: InvalidEmbeddingShape: expected 768, received 769 at batch_index=0, item_index=5
Payload: embedding[5].length=769
```
tess: 769?? that's suspiciously off-by-one. Any chance we double-pad somewhere?
ja: They set env REDWOOD_EMBED_PAD=1 because docs suggested padding for some quantized variants. Their sampleapp docker-compose sets it globally.
omar: Our batch helper has an optional padToMultipleOf param that pads to 8/16 depending on model. If both that and the client-side pad env are applied you'll get double-padding.
cli-bot: Quick note: docker-quickstart image v0.3.1 contains default env REDWOOD_EMBED_PAD=1 (reported in release notes).
nate: Also saw a strange auth interaction: when token refresh occurs mid-batch, the SDK retries with a slightly different routing header which can land on a quantized fallback model that expects a different internal alignment; that + double-pad = 769.
ja: Repro steps I used (local docker):
```
# start sampleapp with pad enabled
REDWOOD_EMBED_PAD=1 docker-compose up --build sampleapp
# send test payload with mixed short/long texts
curl -sv -X POST http://localhost:3000/ingest -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @samples/mixed.json
```
tess: Good repro. I instrumented the batch helper: it pads to 768 then our post-processing (legacy codepath) applied an extra zero to align to 768 % 16 == 1 -> resulting in 769.
omar: Short-term mitigation: sampleapp should never apply global padding env; move pad logic into SDK and make it idempotent (no-op if already correct length). Also server should validate and return clearer JSON error: {"error":"InvalidEmbeddingShape","expected":768,"got":769,"index":5}. Currently it's just a text 400.
ja: Agreed. For onboarding docs: note that model-variant fallbacks may change internal alignment; recommend not toggling pad env in docker quickstart.
cli-bot: CI: docker-quickstart/integration #512 failed on sampleapp onboarding test (dim mismatch) https://ci.redwood/512
nate: I'll open a fix PR for docker-quickstart to remove the env and add a runtime warning if someone sets it. Also will patch node and python SDKs to normalize dims on embeddings before sending to rerank.
omar: Can we add an SDK invariant check that asserts embedding length equals model_profile.dim and throws a helpful error with instructions to run `redwood-cli check-model`?
ja: Yes please. Also add a tiny e2e test that simulates token refresh mid-batch: stub auth endpoint to delay then return new token and assert only one batch processed and dims intact.
tess: I'll file SERVER-802 to improve error payload and include example above. I'll mention returned JSON shape and the HTTP code 422 might be more semantically accurate than 400.
cli-bot: Noted: tickets SERVER-802 and DOCKER-129 created.
ja: Thanks team. Nate/omar/ tess—can we aim to ship the quick doc fix + SDK normalization in this sprint? This one blocks a customer setup.
omar: On it. PRs started: docker-quickstart#58, node-sdk#993, python-sdk#421. Tagging @jia for review.
ja: Thanks. If anyone sees weird odd lengths like 767/769/etc, post logs here and include model name + routing info.
nate: :thumbsup:
